readAs: A real-time AI platform that scores online payment transactions in under 200ms and returns accept, review, or decline before settlement to reduce fraud.
visualBrief: Photographic documentary shot of an empty operations desk at night, no people present. A single unattended monitor shows a plain queue of payment transactions each marked accept, review, or decline with millisecond timing; no brand marks, no readable names, no other UI chrome established. The room and the user remain unspecified.

couldNotPicture.thing: I couldn't picture who actually sits in front of this or operates it day to day (merchant, PSP, fraud analyst, or pure API with no human).
I couldn't picture what the product's own screen or workflow looks like beyond the three decision labels.
I couldn't picture why a buyer would pick this over incumbents — no competitive shape formed at all.
I couldn't picture the founders or any fraud/payments track record behind the claim.
I couldn't picture what the 'volume scored' curve was actually measuring (units, time axis, start/end).
